statement.text:
Is it true that the group algebra k[F ] of R. Thompson’s group F (see 12.20)
over a field k satisfies the Ore condition, that is, for any a, b ∈ k[F ] there exist
u, v ∈ k[F ] such that au = bv and either u or v is nonzero? If the answer is negative,
then F is not amenable.
    Comment of 2026: If the answer is positive, then F is amenable (so problem
15.42 is equivalent to 12.20), because the “if and only if” statement holds for groups
satisfying Kaplansky’s zero-divisor conjecture (D. Kielak, Prepint, 2026, https://
arxiv.org/pdf/1605.09133v2), and F does satisfy it.                         V. S. Guba
